title: Enforce provider-local proxy leases
description: Enforce provider-scoped active egress leases, preserve account IP history across failover, and fail closed when same-provider proxy capacity is exhausted.
public_description: Keep accounts on distinct provider-local proxy egress addresses and fail safely when proxy capacity is unavailable.
internal_description: Enforce provider-scoped active egress leases, preserve account IP history across failover, and fail closed when same-provider proxy capacity is exhausted.
